item.title: Abandoned/excess bins, 14th August
item.description:
For months bins have been dumped at the end of Croft Lane, often blocking vehicle access to the rear of properties in Upper Norwood Street. Now they are attracting flies, foxes & fly tipping (mops, trainers, bucket. Some of the bins belong to houses on Leckhampton Road. Some houses have 2 green bins & keep 1 at the rear of the property& the other just loose on the road. Some residents admit to not wanting the bins within the bounds of their property & prefer to keep them on the road and walk rubbish up. Some residents have put their bin at the rear of the property but not within their boundary so take up valuable access space. These bins have become a hazard.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Croft Lane, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Camber of corner of Hatherley Street and Andover Rd, so disrupted by road repairs that is does not allow rainwater to drain in to any functioning drains nearby, 14th August
item.description:
Corner of Andover Rd and Hatherley St adjacent to 70 Andover Rd. Repeated reports through 25/26 to notify that the blocked drain on main road and the camber of the road corner affected by historic road repairs means that in rain there is excessive flooding on the corner. This is highly problematic for the many pedestrians who cross here. I am reporting again as there has been no action arising from previous reports. We are in drought now, but there will be rain again and there will be a floods this autumn.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 70, Andover Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
